section_summary.extract_value: This preliminary analyses section reports results for a single total sample of 196 Brazilian women, including mean current breast size (M=5.87, SD=3.47), mean ideal BSRS rating (M=7.68, SD=2.38), and mean breast size dissatisfaction (M=-1.81, SD=3.11). Current breast size ratings correlated positively with actual bra size (r = .40) and with BMI (r = .33); 20.6% reported no dissatisfaction while 79.4% reported dissatisfaction (65.5% desired larger, 13.9% desired smaller).
section_summary.evidence_source: The mean rating for current breast size for the total sample (N=196) was 5.87 (SD=3.47)... The mean ideal rating on the BSRS was 7.68 (SD=2.38)... The mean breast size dissatisfaction (signed) score was -1.81 (SD=3.11)... Current breast size ratings were significantly and positively correlated with actual bra size, r=.40, p<.001, and BMI, r=.33, p<.001. In this sample, 20.6% of women reported no breast size dissatisfaction, while 79.4% reported breast size dissatisfaction (65.5% desired a larger breast size and 13.9% desired a smaller breast size).
